alerts.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued October 15 at 2:07AM PDT until October 15 at 9:00AM PDT by NWS Seattle WA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Visibility one quarter mile or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...Eastern Kitsap County, Lowlands of Western Skagit and
Northwestern Snohomish Counties, Lowlands of Western Whatcom
County, City of Seattle, Downtown Everett / Marysville Area,
Lowlands of Lewis and Southern Thurston Counties, Lowlands of
Pierce and Southern King Counties, Olympia and Southern Puget
Sound, and Shoreline / Lynnwood / South Everett Area.

* WHEN...Until 9 AM PDT this morning.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.

sonora_ca.name: Sonora
sonora_ca.obs_note: Sonora has no NWS observing station. The readings come from the Green Spring fire-weather station, 12 miles away and about 700 ft lower.

alerts.headline: Red Flag Warning issued October 15 at 12:24AM PDT until October 16 at 10:00AM PDT by NWS Sacramento CA
alerts.description:
...RED FLAG WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 10 AM PDT FRIDAY DUE TO
WIND AND LOW RELATIVE HUMIDITY FOR PORTIONS OF CENTRAL AND NORTHERN
CALIFORNIA...

* AFFECTED AREA...Portions of central and northern California.

* TIMING...Until 10 AM PDT Friday.

* WINDS...Northeast to east winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts 25 to 45
mph.

* RELATIVE HUMIDITY...Daytime humidity 10 to 20% with single digits
possible and very poor overnight recoveries.

* IMPACTS...Any fires that develop will spread rapidly. Outdoor
burning is not recommended.

alerts.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 15 at 2:55AM PDT until October 16 at 11:00AM PDT by NWS Las Vegas NV
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 50 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Southern Owens Valley, Northwest Plateau, Hualapai
Mountains, Northwest Deserts, Death Valley National Park, Western
Clark and Southern Nye County, Sheep Range, and Spring
Mountains-Red Rock Canyon.

* WHEN...From 8 AM PDT /8 AM MST/ this morning to 11 AM PDT /11 AM
MST/ Friday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
